name: ProbeGlass
description: ProbeGlass is a small self-hosted watchdog for your homelab. It probes your services on a schedule, keeps their history in a single SQLite file, draws the graphs, and tells you when something breaks. Sensors for HTTP, TCP, TLS certificates, ping, DNS, Docker containers and SNMP; alerts over Telegram, Matrix, ntfy, Slack, Discord or a webhook.

paths.name: Appdata
paths.description: SQLite database, its write-ahead log, and probeglass.yaml. The container takes the folder over on start, so it does not have to be prepared by hand.

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: User ID for file permissions. The container starts as root, hands the appdata folder to this user and then runs as it. Leave it at 500, which is the user every other template here runs as.

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: Group ID for file permissions. See PUID.

variables.name: UMASK
variables.description: File creation mask for new files, in octal. 022 leaves the owner full access and everyone else read-only.

variables.name: Data Directory
variables.description: Optional. Directory holding the database. This is the path the Appdata entry above is mounted at; change it only if you change that mount.

variables.name: Database Path
variables.description: Optional. Full path to the SQLite file. Empty means <data directory>/probeglass.db, which is almost always what you want.

variables.name: Listen Address
variables.description: Optional. host:port the dashboard and the API are served on. Has to match the port mapping above.

variables.name: Log Format
variables.description: Optional. text for reading along, json for a log collector.

variables.name: Trust Proxy Headers
variables.description: Optional. Set to true only when a reverse proxy you control sits in front of it: it makes the daemon believe X-Forwarded-For and X-Forwarded-Proto. Without a proxy in front, that lets a client pick the address it appears to come from.

variables.name: Retention: Raw
variables.description: Optional. How long raw probes are kept. Accepts 30s, 5m, 2h, 7d, 2w, or a bare number of seconds.

variables.name: Retention: Hourly
variables.description: Optional. How long the hourly rollups behind the long-range graphs are kept.

variables.name: Base URL
variables.description: Optional. The address you reach the dashboard on, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:8080. Alert messages link back to it; empty means no link is added. Type it out in full — [IP] and [PORT] are not substituted here.

variables.name: Admin Password
variables.description: Optional. Skips the setup screen on a fresh database; ignored once a password has been stored.

variables.name: Configuration File
variables.description: Optional. Path to a YAML file declaring sensors and channels. Careful: if this is set, the file has to exist or the daemon refuses to start. Empty means <data directory>/probeglass.yaml is used when it is there.
